common_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production UI art asset for Kids & Dragons. Warm storybook painting read by lamplight, chunky readable shapes, restrained low-detail brushwork, old gold/brass #6b5430 #b08a3e #f5c86c, plum leather #2a1f45 to #110c22, deep violet #1a1730, subtle teal accents. Straight-on orthographic, aligned to canvas, not a perspective object or mockup. Decoration ONLY at edges, all text areas completely calm. No text, letters, digits, red trim, silver or white trim, watermarks, extra objects, drop shadow outside canvas. Asset must occupy prescribed aspect ratio; generate on transparent canvas except full-bleed material tiles. Nine-slice edges must be completely plain lengthwise, with all corner motifs entirely within stated insets. Keep same family materials and geometry across states.
